QF.id: Cat III AIF Fees and Performance_24

question.text: A Cat III AIF has Capital Rs. 100 crore, Hurdle 8%, Incentive 20%. Year 1 NAV pre-incentives is Rs. 116 crore. What is the incentive fee payable?

explanation.text: The Logic: Reference Hurdle Y1 = 100 × 1.08 = 108 crore. Excess = 116 − 108 = 8 crore. Incentive = 20% × 8 = Rs. 1.60 crore. The Trap: Rs. 3.20 crore uses 16% ; Rs. 16 crore ignores hurdle; Rs. 10 crore is arbitrary. Cross-Exam Context: Standard hurdle-catchup style computation. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Run the calc by the fund accountant quarterly — ensures no discrepancy at year-end.
